name: Kerbal Space Program
description: Build rockets and run a space program together. Luna Multiplayer shares one game between players: the same Kerbin, vessels, contracts and a common clock, with everyone flying at once.

setup.title: Kerbal Space Program
setup.detail: Install Kerbal Space Program from your Steam library.
Download the mod above: Cairn puts it, and Harmony which it needs, in the game's GameData folder.

hostSteps: Download the mod above. Cairn puts it in the game's GameData folder and keeps it up to date.
Hosting needs Luna Multiplayer's server (LMPServer, from the project's releases page): start it on your PC and forward its port, 8800 (UDP).
Press Play to start Kerbal Space Program and open Luna Multiplayer from its button in the main menu.
Connect to your own server by its address and share that address with your friends.
joinSteps: Download the mod above, the same version as the server's, then press Play.
Open Luna Multiplayer from its button in the main menu.
Pick a server in the list, or type the host's address, and connect.

items.name: Join a server
items.detail: Join friends' servers by address, or public ones from the server list. The mod and the server must be the same version.

items.name: Kept up to date
items.detail: Cairn installs the mod and the Harmony library it needs in the game's folder and updates them when a new version is released.

items.name: Vessels and flights
items.detail: Vessels, docking, time warp and the common clock are shared between players.

items.name: Career and science
items.detail: Funds, science, contracts and technology are shared in career and science games.
